description: This file defines the KpiModel class within a human resource management plugin for performance KPIs. It models KPI data, supports serialization to array, and interacts with KPI services and entities.

classes.name: KpiModel
classes.description: A model class representing KPI data for serialization and API responses, including logic to determine if a KPI is deletable.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the KpiModel with a Kpi entity, setting up filters and attribute mappings.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the KPI model to an array, including a check if the KPI is deletable.
